title: A 2 mm Bug Does the Fastest Backflip on Earth, Without Using Its Legs

scenes.text: The fastest backflips on Earth belong to a bug.
Globular springtails are only about two millimetres long.
They don't jump with legs. A forked tail called a furca flicks against the ground.
It launches them over 60 millimetres, more than 60 times their body height.
Spinning at up to 368 rotations a second.
The whole flip takes about one thousandth of a second.

description:
The fastest backflips on Earth belong to a bug.
Globular springtails flick a forked tail to launch more than 60 times their body height, spinning up to 368 times a second.
What is the smallest animal you have ever seen jump?
first_comment: Which would you rather be able to do: backflip like a springtail or fly like a bird?
